video_caption: A man in a black cardigan and white shirt stands on the right, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with his hands. To his left, a presentation slide is displayed. From 00:05 to 00:20, the slide shows "IONOS CLOUD" and "nextcloud" logos with the text "Dr. Martin Endress CCO IONOS" against an abstract blue digital background featuring glowing lines and interconnected cubes. At 00:20, the slide changes to a blue gradient background, displaying "IONOS CLOUD and nextcloud share the same vision" at the top. A white speech bubble contains the quote: "The Partnership with Nextcloud is based on the same vision of European data sovereignty." Below the quote, a circular photo shows a smiling man with blonde hair in a suit, identified by the text "Achim Weiß - CEO IONOS Founder of Profitbricks." The speaker continues to talk and gesture throughout the segment.

In this video segment, a man with short dark hair, wearing a black cardigan over a white shirt, stands against a plain white background on the right side of the frame, speaking directly to the camera and using hand gestures to emphasize his points. On the left side of the frame is a blue slide with white text and logos. At the top, it reads "IONOS CLOUD and nextcloud share the same vision". Below this, a white text box contains a quote: ""The Partnership with Nextcloud is based on the same vision of European data sovereignty"" (The Partnership with Nextcloud is based on the same vision of European data sovereignty). Underneath the quote, it identifies the speaker as "Achim Weiß - CEO IONOS Founder of Profitbricks". To the right of the text box is a circular headshot of a smiling man.

The video opens with a split screen presentation. On the right, a man with short, dark hair, wearing a black cardigan over a white collared shirt, is speaking directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. On the left, a blue-toned slide is displayed, featuring text and a circular profile picture of a different man smiling. The text at the top of the slide reads: "IONOS CLOUD and nextcloud share the same vision". Below this, a white text box contains a quote: "“The Partnership with Nextcloud is based on the same vision of European data sovereignty”", attributed to "Achim Weiß - CEO IONOS Founder of Profitbricks". The speaker on the right is likely introducing or discussing the partnership described on the slide.

The video segment features a blue gradient background with the white text "...building a truly European Cloud Solution" in the top left and the "IONOS CLOUD" logo in the top right. Centered on the screen is a three-tiered cloud computing diagram: the bottom tier is labeled "Host" and contains a blue cloud with "IaaS" written on it, positioned above two server rack illustrations. To its right, a list of components includes "Operating System," "Virtual Machines," "Servers," "Storage," and "Networking & DC Fabric." The middle tier is labeled "Build" and features a teal cloud with "PaaS" written on it. To its right, the listed components are "Managed Kubernetes" and "Backup." The top tier is labeled "Consume" and displays a dark grey cloud with "SaaS" written on it. A white upward arrow passes through the center of the three clouds, indicating a progression. At the start of the segment, the "IaaS" cloud is subtly highlighted with a brighter blue outline.

In this video segment, a man with short, dark hair, wearing a white collared shirt under a black cardigan, stands against a plain white background on the right side of the screen. He looks directly at the viewer, speaking with a serious and engaged expression, using hand gestures with his hands initially open and then closing into loose fists to emphasize his points. To the left, a presentation slide is displayed on a blue background. The slide's title reads "...building a truly European Cloud Solution" at the top left, with "IONOS Enterprise" logo at the top right. A prominent layered diagram illustrates cloud service models: "Consume" (SaaS, dark gray layer), "Build" (PaaS, light blue layer), and "Host" (IaaS, dark blue layer), with two server racks underneath the IaaS layer. Text labels connected to PaaS list "Managed Kubernetes" and "Backup," while IaaS is associated with "Operating System," "Virtual Machines," "Servers," "Storage," and "Networking & DC Fabric."

A man with short dark hair, wearing a dark blue long-sleeved shirt over a white collared shirt, stands in the foreground, speaking and gesturing with his hands. Behind him, a presentation slide is displayed. At the segment's start (0:00-0:01), the slide is titled "...building a truly European Cloud Solution" and shows a diagram of cloud layers: "Consume" (SaaS), "Build" (PaaS), and "Host" (IaaS), with associated services like "Managed Kubernetes" and "Operating System" listed to the right. At 0:01, the slide transitions to "What we guarantee our customers," featuring five columns with icons and bullet points. The columns are: "Performant" (depicting a person on a surfboard, with points like "Rising star" for cloud (ISG) and "Stellar compute/storage perform." (Cloud Spectator)), "Secure" (a cloud with a padlock, listing "Geo Redundancy," "GDPR compliant," and "Not subject to US Cloud Act"), "Easy-to-use" (a person dragging and dropping elements, mentioning "Drag-and-Drop Data Center Designer" and "Cloud APIs"), "Fair" (a graph with a euro sign, highlighting "Supreme value" (Cloud Spectator) and "No vendor lock-in"), and "Open" (headphones with stars, listing "Open Source" and "Top 20 Linux Kernel 5.8 contributor"). The speaker continues to elaborate on these points, occasionally using hand gestures to emphasize his words.

The video opens with a full view of a slide titled "What we guarantee our customers" (with the "IONOS CLOUD" logo in the top right corner), which quickly transitions to show a man in a black long-sleeved polo shirt or sweater speaking from the right side of the screen, with the slide visible on the left. The man, with short dark hair, gestures expressively with his hands, opening his palms and occasionally touching his fingertips as he talks directly to the camera, maintaining an engaged and conversational expression. The slide, set against a blue background, is organized into five columns, each with an icon, a title, and bullet points. The columns are: "Performant" (icon: person surfing on a data wave) detailing "Rising star" for cloud (ISG), "Stellar compute/ storage perform." (Cloud Spectator), flexibility on RAM, vCores, HDD/SSD, and Infiniband (HPC); "Secure" (icon: building with a lock) listing Geo Redundancy, Data backup and disaster recovery, Firewalls and load balancer, GDPR compliant, and "Not subject to US Cloud Act"; "Easy-to-use" (icon: person dragging and dropping elements) featuring Drag-and-Drop Data Center Designer, SDN 2.0, Cloud APIs, and Managed Services: K8, Private Cloud; "Fair" (icon: fluctuating graph with Euro symbol) highlighting "Supreme value" (Cloud Spectator), No vendor lock-in (ingress=egress), No hidden cost, and 24/7 enterprise level support (DE/EN); and "Open" (icon: person with headphones, stars, and Linux penguin logo) mentioning Open Source, Top 20 Linux Kernel 5.8 contributor, Channel partner (e.g., Bechtle), and Tech partner (e.g., Nextcloud, OX).

A man with dark hair, wearing a white shirt and a black V-neck sweater, stands in front of a white background, speaking and gesturing animatedly with his hands. To his left, a white slide titled "What we guarantee our customers" with the IONOS logo lists five categories: "Performant," "Secure," "Easy-to-use," "Fair," and "Open," each with bullet points detailing features like "Drag-and-Drop Data Center Designer" and "No hidden cost." At 0:47, the slide seamlessly transitions to a blue promotional image with the title "Our partnership started this year..." and details about "Nextcloud Hub hosted by IONOS." The image displays text in German: "Eine neue Generation der Zusammenarbeit" (A new generation of collaboration), "File-Sharing, Dokumentenbearbeitung & Kommunikation" (File-sharing, document editing & communication), "Keine Speicher- oder Benutzerbegrenzung" (No storage or user limit), "100% in Deutschland gehostet & entwickelt" (100% hosted & developed in Germany), and a button labeled "Kontakt anfordern" (Request contact), featuring two men collaborating on a laptop and the Nextcloud logo. The speaker claps his hands once during the transition, maintaining a serious expression as the video cuts off suddenly.

A man wearing a dark cardigan over a white shirt stands against a white background on the right side of the frame, speaking and gesturing with both hands, his expression engaged. To his left, a blue-background slide is displayed, titled "We build solutions for three customer types" (English). The slide is divided into three sections: "Enterprise Customers" (English), which describes "nextcloud on IONOS cloud: high-performing instance for Nextcloud admins, no user or storage limitations; adaptable to the individual needs of your business" (English) with an icon of a person using a large screen; "Public Sector" (English), detailing "highly-secure and scalable infrastructure, hosted in Germany, GDPR compliance for sensitive demands; German Schulcloud and Project Phoenix" (English) with an icon of servers; and "Private and SMB" (English), marked with a "COMING SOON" (English) badge, which outlines "ready-2-use nextcloud w/o administrative skills; 'Nextcloud for everybody' - fully managed, no thrills; work-from-home focus" (English) alongside an icon of stacked server units. The "IONOS CLOUD" and "Nextcloud" logos are visible in the top right corner of the slide. At 0:13, the man fades out as the slide smoothly transitions to fill the entire screen, making its content the sole focus.

The video segment displays a static slide on a light blue background, titled "We build solutions for three customer types" at the top center. In the top right corner, the "IONOS cloud" and "Nextcloud" logos are visible. The slide is divided into three vertical sections, each outlining a customer type with an accompanying illustration, title, and descriptive text. The left section, labeled "Enterprise Customers," features an illustration of two individuals interacting with large screens displaying charts and cloud symbols, alongside text that reads: "nextcloud on IONOS cloud: high-performing instance for Nextcloud admins, no user or storage limitations; adoptable to the individual needs of your business." The middle section, titled "Public Sector," shows an illustration of a server rack with a laptop displaying network connections and cloud icons, accompanied by the text: "highly-secure and scalable infrastructure, hosted in Germany, GDPR compliance for sensitive demands; German Schulcloud and Project Phoenix." The right section, labeled "Private and SMB" with a small "COMING SOON" text above the title, illustrates server racks and a person holding a laptop. Its descriptive text states: "ready-2-use nextcloud w/o administrative skills; "Nextcloud for everybody" - fully managed, no thrills; work-from-home focus."

The video segment begins with a slide on a blue-grey background titled "We build solutions for three customer types," displaying the "IONOS CLOUD" logo in the top left and the "Nextcloud" logo in the top right. The slide is divided into three columns, each representing a customer type with an accompanying illustration and descriptive text: "Enterprise Customers" (a person interacting with a large screen displaying charts and data, with text describing "nextcloud on IONOS cloud: high-performing instance for Nextcloud admins, no user or storage limitations; adaptable to the individual needs of your business"), "Public Sector" (server racks with cloud icons and a monitor, with text mentioning "highly-secure and scalable infrastructure, hosted in Germany, GDPR compliance for sensitive demands; German Schulcloud and Project Phoenix"), and "Private and SMB" (multiple server racks with small figures, a "COMING SOON" badge, and text stating "ready-2-use nextcloud w/o administrative skills; 'Nextcloud for everybody' - fully managed, no thrills; work-from-home focus"). At 0:12, a man with short dark hair, wearing a black V-neck sweater over a white collared shirt, fades into the frame from the right, partially overlapping the "Private and SMB" section, which becomes semi-transparent. He maintains a direct gaze at the camera, speaking with a focused expression, and frequently uses expressive hand gestures, such as bringing his hands together, spreading them, making a fist, and gesturing palms up to punctuate his points, against a plain white background behind him.

A man in a black cardigan over a white shirt stands on the right against a plain white background, speaking directly to the camera and using expressive hand gestures, including open palms and clasped hands. On the left side of the screen, a presentation slide is displayed on a blue background with "IONOS" and "Nextcloud" logos at the top right. Initially, the slide is titled "We build solutions for three customer types" and is divided into three sections: "Enterprise Customers" (describing "nextcloud on IONOS cloud" with details about performance, limitations, and adaptability), "Public Sector" (detailing "highly-secure and scalable infrastructure, hosted in Germany, GDPR compliance for sensitive demands: German Schulcloud and Project Phoenix"), and "Private and SMB" (mentioning "ready-2-use nextcloud w/o administrative skills, 'Nextcloud for everybody', fully managed, no thrills, work-from-home focus," with a "COMING SOON" badge). The man continues to speak with a positive expression, and the slide then transitions to a new one titled "This is just the beginning..." with an illustration of a person sitting on a cloud using a tablet. Below the illustration, text provides information: "...for more information go to ionos.de/enterprise-cloud/nextcloud" and "...and snatch a cloud server with 200€ (Euros) starting credit ionos.de/cloud/cloud-server". The man concludes his address, gesturing with open hands.
